concerns.text: T023 and T024 are unchecked (marked 'rejected' in analysis) but are hard dependencies for T025 (Classification). T025 consumes `data/processed/features_matrix.csv` produced by T023. Without T023 completing, T025 cannot execute, blocking User Story 3 entirely. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule.

T029 (FWE correction) depends on T028a (t-test results) but also writes to `data/processed/feature_metadata.json`. T024 is the designated task to create/populate this file. Since T024 is unchecked/failed, T029 has no valid target artifact to append to, creating a circular dependency failure in the statistical validation phase.

T039 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but the task description explicitly states it 'must complete before T010' to prevent synthetic data generation. A task with a hard sequential dependency on a downstream task (T010) cannot be parallel-safe with the rest of the Foundational phase if T010 is also running. The [P] tag is misleading here.

T023 description lacks specific schema definition (e.g., column headers) for `features_matrix.csv`. While T022 validates data, T023 must explicitly define the output format to ensure T025 can parse it correctly, preventing silent failures in the consumer task.
